shortDescription: Restore device configuration to network devices over network_cli

options.name: filename
options.description: Filename of the backup file, present in the appliance where the restore operation is to be performed. Check appliance for the configuration backup file name.

options.name: path
options.description: The location in the target appliance where the file containing the backup exists. The path and the filename together create the input to the config replace command, For an IOSXE appliance the path pattern is flash://<filename>
